ow_hud_switch_safety.reason: All 36 shared GFX 0x2A tiles (including space 0x1F and digits 0x22..0x2B used by OW life counter at VRAM 0x5087..0x5088, plus File-Select MARIO/PLAYER/ERASE DATA tiles) are byte-for-byte identical between boss (ja) and r46 (en). MARIO label on OW is not in BG3 GFX 0x2A.

en_tile_translator.description: Maps US-SMW-encoded English GFX 0x2A tile indices (used in demo6/demo7 English strings) to Demo 1-1 (r46) GFX 0x2A tile indices.
smwu_vs_r46_differing_tiles: 0x22..0x2B (outlined digits in SMWU/demo6/demo7 -> plain digits in r46/boss; visually valid 0-9)
0x6C (US HUD tile -> JP SA in r46; unused in message/OW strings)
0x77 (US HUD tile -> JP WO in r46; unused in message/OW strings)
0x7B..0x7C (US Title/HUD tiles -> box corners in r46; unused in message/OW strings)

stripe_audit.title_stripe_note: boss uses GFX 0x28 tiles 38,39,48,49,55,56,65,66 for JP Title border/subtitle; r46 blanks 55,56,65,66 and replaces them with 57,58,59 brick border. File-Select stripes ($05:B0FF, $05:B91C, $05:B872, $05:B8C7) are identical between boss and r46 and use only shared GFX 0x28/0x29/0x2A/0x2B tiles.
